Change pin.

Change a card PIN.
Verifies `old_pin_hash` against the stored `pin_hash`; on success the
stored hash is replaced with `new_pin_hash` and `pin_attempts` is
reset. On failure `pin_attempts` is incremented (same policy as
`verify_pin`).
